Former Coaches File Lawsuits Alleging Retaliation

Two former college sports coaches have filed federal lawsuits alleging retaliation. The former women's golf coach at Chattanooga filed a lawsuit alleging retaliation. Separately, a former volleyball coach at San Jose State University (SJSU) filed a new lawsuit alleging retaliation for their support of Donald Trump and their religion, amidst a transgender scandal.
